segments.text: Welcome back to GitHub awesome. This is GitHub trending weekly number 32. We have gathered 35 trending repositories on GitHub. Let's get into it.
CAD tools have a steep learning curve that keeps most software engineers from ever getting into 3D printing. Text to CAD sidesteps the problem entirely.
Instead of asking an LLM to reason spatially, the agent writes Python using build 13D and CAD query to generate parts deterministically.
Describe what you want. Get precise step, STL, GLB, DXF, and URDF files out.
Built-in web viewer previews each iteration.
Open Claw has 360,000 stars and over 13,000 open issues, most of them outdated, fixed, or AI generated noise.
Peter Steinberger built Claw Sweeper, an autonomous AI maintainer that orchestrates 50 parallel codeex agents to review every open issue against the
current main branch. The AI operates readonly, writes a fully auditable markdown file explaining exactly why an
issue should be closed based on seven narrow conservative criteria.
Free API tiers from Gro, Google, Mistl, and Nvidia are toys on their own. Stack them and you get 1.3 billion free tokens
a month. Free LMAP is a local OpenAI compatible proxy aggregating 14 providers behind one endpoint. Hit a rate limit on grow mid chat and it
transparently reroutes to Samanova or Cloudflare. Keys encrypted in local SQLite React admin dashboard included.
Orchestrating dozens of AI agents usually requires heavy frameworks pulling in a gigabyte of Python dependencies.
Harmonist is a portable orchestration engine with zero runtime dependencies. Ships with 186 specialized agents.
Strict programmatic protocols govern agent communication and task handoffs instead of fragile natural language prompts. Your AI swarm behaves like a disciplined microser architecture.
SQLite single file magic breaks the moment you need a task cue. Honker is a loadable SQLite extension written in Rust that brings Postgress style notify
and listen natively to SQLite. Durable pub sub task cues event streams all in your existing database file. Same atomic
transaction for business logic and Q tasks. No polling. Singledigit millisecond latency.
Dclaw is an open- source agent harness in Rust. Three interfaces in one binary.
desktop guey CLI ripple for SSH and non-interactive mode for CI/CD agent teams orchestration using T-Ux and
separate git work trees it spawns multiple independent sub aents working in parallel one writes back end another builds front end in an isolated branch a
lead agent merges through a shared mailbox agents forget everything sessing chat
history into context just retrieves old text it doesn't learn stash is a self-hosted persistent memory layer
connecting claude code via MCP. Go binary backed by Postgress and PG Vector, an eight-stage background consolidation pipeline that extracts
structured facts and memorizes failure patterns so your agent never makes the same coding mistake twice.
Babysitting AI agents through every step of a project gets old fast. One man, inspired by Japanese oneman trains, is
an open- source agent matrix runtime in Typescript. Spin up an entire virtual team. Strategist, developer, QA tester.
You step into observer mode. Local agents coordinate with each other, pass work back and forth, share notes, and produce final artifacts fully
autonomously. No human prompts in the loop.
Deepseek just open sourced the GPU kernels underneath their models. Tile kernels is written entirely in tile lang and bypasses standard libraries to
extract maximum floatingpoint throughput directly from NVIDIA hopper and blackwell architectures. Optimized mixture of experts routing FP8 and FP4
per channel quantization specialized engram gating the exact kernels DeepSeek runs internally.
Your entire life's work sits on GitHub one flagged account or accidental deletion away from disaster.
Git backup is an ultra lightweight CLI from Hesh Chudhari. Hand it an API token and it pageionates through your account,
fetches every public and private repo and compresses them into local archives.
Drop it into a cron job and it silently backs up to your NAS or cloud bucket every midnight.
Computer use mode in claude or codeex hijacks your physical mouse and keyboard. Your machine becomes useless while the AI clicks around. Background
computer use fixes that. The creator reverse engineered Codeex's background protocols and built a native Mac OS API
in Swift. Your AI controls native Mac apps, clicks UI elements, and manages multi-wind workflows entirely in the background.
Gard DPWM is a pure RDP client running directly in your browser built in Go compiled to web assembly. A lightweight
Go proxy bridges a web soocket from your browser straight into the target Windows RDP port. Renders the desktop onto an HTML 5 canvas. maps keyboard scan codes,
tracks mouse, even streams remote audio via web audio API.
Want to code from your couch without touching a keyboard? Hypervibe turns an Apple TV remote into a one-handed programming interface for clawed code.
Native Mac OS Swift app connects via Bluetooth, maps, custom buttons, and trackpad gestures. Lean back, hold a
button to dictate prompts to your agent, use the trackpad to scroll diffs, accept suggestions, and fire terminal shortcuts
with your thumb. What if your AI assistant never slept and could browse the web while writing code? Bucks from
the browser use team turns clawed code into a persistent, always digital worker. Wires your agent into browser harness, their self-healing web
automation framework. Your AI autonomously opens browsers, scrapes docs, clicks through web apps, and visually tests UI changes while you
sleep. Love the raw speed of Arya 2, but hate the terminal configs. Arya.x is a native download manager for the Apple
ecosystem in Swift UI. Wraps the full area 2 engine in a gorgeous Mac OS and iOS app. Zero configuration. The engine
is builtin. Download locally or connect via JSON RPC to manage tasks on your NAS. Native Safari extension. Apple
Shortcut support. History stays in your private iCloud.
Dark Passwords turns the cheap Lily Go T display S3 microcontroller into an offline encrypted vault. Encrypted vault
instead of plain text storage. USB and Bluetooth HID handlers separated to fix keyboard conflicts. Strict validation
rejects dangerous control characters so the device can't be tricked into malicious keystrokes. CSRF protection on the Wi-Fi portal, firstr run pin setup.
Inav is a top tier enterprisegrade Minecraft antiche that protected some of the largest networks since 2016. The
team just shut down commercial operations and released the entire project source available. Simulates player movement, clientside entities,
and block data on the server to catch the tiniest manipulations.
speed hacks, fly exploits, aimbots, auto clickers.
Building polished UI animations usually means importing frame or motion.
Transitions.dev is a curated interactive collection of essential UI transitions you copy and paste directly into your project. No npm packages, no
dependencies, card resizing, drop- down menus, digit flipping, notification badges, all as portable zerobloat CSS
snippets with namespaced rules and prefers reduced motion guards.
AI4 animations neural motion matching generates lielike biped and quadriped movement, but running those networks usually requires Unity or a Python
PyTorch backend. AI4N web GPU ports the entire inference engine to the web. Pure TypeScript and 3JS with web GPU running the neural networks fully client side.
Batched compute fires one dispatch per prediction tick across every agent on screen.
Hermes Labyrinth replaces the boring web dashboard with a spatial interactive visualization environment.
Maps your agents decision-m process as a dynamic navigable graph. Watch your agent explore different branches in real
time. see exactly where it hits a dead end or hallucinates. Track how it backtracks to find the correct path. The
creator builds ECS-based game engines for AI agents. So, this tool treats the agents thoughts and actions as spatial entities.
Finished an epic hike and want more than a phone screenshot? Trail print 3D turns GPX files into 3D printable terrain
maps. Blender add-on fetches real world elevation data, generates detailed terrain centered on your exact route.
Taps open street map to add raised lakes, rivers, forests, and city buildings. Customize the shape. Export a
print ready STL. Single color or automatic multiolor painting for Bamboo Lab. Bob, bring your own browser. A
lightweight MCP server and Chrome extension combo that lets your AI agent securely use the actual Chrome browser you already have open, already logged
into your Gmail, Twitter, Slack, and GitHub. 16 built-in tools. Scroll, click, type, export markdown, pull
network HAR files, grab session cookies for curl scripts. Strict local sandboxing keeps it out of your password manager.
Long clawed code sessions drift. The agent forgets the plan, hallucinates broken code, and wanders away from the original goal. EvanFlow fixes that with
16 agent skills that enforce a strict TDD feedback loop. Every task walks through brainstorm, plan, execute, TDD,
iterate. Red green refactor cycles gated by actual testr runner results, not the agents confidence. Failing test first code to pass it, then refactor.
Another take on Karpathy's LLM wiki pattern with one constraint that makes it more disciplined. Claude won't generate a concept article from a single
source. Themes log is candidates first and only crystallize when a second independent source confirms them. Clean split. You write into inbox. Claude
writes into sources in wiki. Never the other way. Four commands ingest, compile, ask, lint, clone, open in Obsidian, run clawed code.
Nvidia SME showing 100% utilization is misleading. A kernel being active and a kernel doing useful work are completely
different things. Utilize reads raw hardware performance counters to show actual compute efficiency. The killer
feature is attainable so it discovers your inference server, analyzes your model and hardware, calculates your realistic performance ceiling, and tells
you exactly how much you're leaving on the table.
DBaver is overkill for exploring a local SQLite database when you're already in the terminal. SQV is a polished Rust TUI
for exploring, querying, and navigating SQLite tables with full Vim key bindings. Ships as a deb or via cargo.
The creator revealed this highly polished interface was largely AI generated, a clean showcase of what modern agents can ship fast.
Tired of AI agents praising your messy code with LGTM? Marco is a grumpy, brutally honest, senior code reviewer
for clawed code and codecs. Type Marco and he grabs your uncommitted git diffs and issues a one-word verdict. Catastrophe, bad, mediocre, or okay.
Okay. Is the highest praise you'll ever get. concrete file and line gripes, refuses to suggest fixes, forces sharp actionable critique instead of vague boilerplate.
QFS is a single binary go knowledge server with zero configuration pointed at a folder of markdown and it serves
them up through an obsidian style web interface. It auto turns the folder into a git repo. Every UI edit or any
markdown your AI agent writes with echo or cat gets version controlled and committed in the background. SQLite search builtin. No proprietary database lockin.
Beaver Atlas takes the LLM wiki pattern to team chat. Self-hosted ingest Slack, Teams, and Discord. Uses AI to extract
atomic facts and relationships instead of raw message chunks. Weate for semantics, Neo Forj for relationship mapping, compiles everything into a
structured wiki humans can actually read. Built-in MCP server lets Claude code and cursor query it with inline citations to the original messages.
Open clickie from Jason Nin is a native Mac OS menu bar app. Pushto talk voice commands and the AI actually sees your screen and responds contextually. Cursor
overlay points at UI elements. Agent mode bundles codecs for coding research and automation. Runs on your own claude
11 labs and open AI keys. No force login, no cloud sync.
Signal is a self-hosted AI native CRM and outreach engine that acts as your autonomous SDR. Watches the web for
buying signals like funding rounds, hiring changes, and product launches via browser base and stage hand. When a warm
lead pops, it enriches the data, has clawed draft hyperpersonalized outreach, and runs multi-step email sequences with open and reply tracking.
Boring static neovim startup screens are over. Millie.nvm NVM brings buttery smooth animated asy splash screens, 29
built-ins, including a spinning black hole. The Neovim subreddit is going wild over a CLI and web playground that
converts any image or GIF into a custom animated splash screen. Integrates with your existing dashboard plugin so recent files and shortcuts stay intact.
Hard- coding API tokens for cloud code means credentials leak into shell history or dump into the AI's context.
Sigali is a zero trust authentication layer. Spins up a local MITM proxy. Your agent routes traffic through it and
Sigali auto injects AES-26 encrypted cookies and headers on the fly. The agent gets the API data but never sees your actual credentials.
AI agents can act through tool calling, but they're passive by default, waiting for a prompt before doing anything.
World 2 agent flips that with an open protocol that standardizes how agents perceive the physical world. Plug in
sensors that speak a unified schema and your agent gets a constant stream of structured real-time data about its environment.
You have a quick thought while coding.
Switch to your notes app. Find your daily log. Type switch back. Focus is gone. Marquee is a native Mac OS menu
bar app that sits over whatever you're working in. Assign a global hotkey. Hit it when an idea strikes. Type in the
minimal panel that slides over. Press return and it appends directly to your markdown file.
That wraps up all 35 projects featured in GitHub Trending Weekly 32. All links are in the description. A special thank you to the 18 awesome supporter members.
Your support is the driving force behind these updates.
